mapper.select: /** [sql-warehousing.xml] WarehousingMapper.getWarehousingList **/ SELECT A.*, B.*, C.*, A.PU02_QTY * PU02_COST AS PU02_TOTAL, C.CM08_NAME AS PU02_CODE_NM, D.CM01_NAME AS PU01_CUS_NM, COALESCE(E.TOTAL_QTY - C.CM08_ORDQTY,0) AS PU02_STOCK, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ST02_IPQTY),0) FROM TB_ST_02 WHERE ST02_COMPANY = #{company} AND ST02_FACTORY = #{factory} AND ST02_PURNO = A.PU02_HNO AND ST02_CODE = A.PU02_CODE) AS PU02_IPQTY_TOT, DECODE(QA05.QA05_AVAILABLE, 'Y', 'W', 'S') AS ST02_STATUS, NVL(QA05.QA05_AVAILABLE, 'N') AS QA05_AVAILABLE FROM TB_PU_02 A LEFT JOIN TB_PU_01 B ON B.PU01_NO = A.PU02_HNO AND B.PU01_COMPANY = A.PU02_COMPANY AND B.PU01_FACTORY = A.PU02_FACTORY LEFT JOIN TB_CM_08 C ON A.PU02_CODE = C.CM08_CODE AND A.PU02_COMPANY = C.CM08_COMPANY AND A.PU02_FACTORY = C.CM08_FACTORY LEFT JOIN TB_CM_01 D ON A.PU02_CUS = D.CM01_CODE AND A.PU02_COMPANY = D.CM01_COMPANY AND A.PU02_FACTORY = D.CM01_FACTORY LEFT JOIN (SELECT ST01_CODE, ST01_COMPANY, ST01_FACTORY, SUM(E.ST01_QTY) AS TOTAL_QTY FROM TB_ST_01 E GROUP BY E.ST01_COMPANY, E.ST01_FACTORY, E.ST01_CODE) E ON A.PU02_COMPANY = E.ST01_COMPANY AND A.PU02_FACTORY = E.ST01_FACTORY AND A.PU02_CODE = E.ST01_CODE LEFT JOIN TB_QA_05 QA05 ON QA05.QA05_COMPANY = A.PU02_COMPANY AND QA05.QA05_FACTORY = A.PU02_FACTORY AND QA05.QA05_CODE = A.PU02_CODE AND QA05.QA05_SDT < TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND QA05.QA05_EDT > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') WHERE 1=1 AND PU02_COMPANY = #{company} AND PU02_FACTORY = #{factory} AND A.PU02_HNO = #{pu01No} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ST_02 ST02 WHERE ST02.ST02_PNO = A.PU02_HNO) = 0 ORDER BY A.PU02_LNO
mapper.insert: /** [sql-warehousing.xml] WarehousingMapper.insertOfLotStock **/ INSERT INTO tb_st_01 ( st01_company, st01_factory, st01_gbn, st01_lot, st01_lot_seq, st01_code, st01_stok, st01_district, st01_field, st01_unt, st01_qty ) values ( #{company}, #{factory}, #{gbn}, #{lot}, #{lotSeq}, #{code}, #{stock}, COALESCE(#{st01District}, null), COALESCE(#{st01Field}, null), #{unt}, #{ipQty} )

/** [sql-warehousing.xml] WarehousingMapper.insertOfInputHistory **/ INSERT INTO tb_st_02 ( st02_company, st02_factory, st02_no, st02_dat, st02_seq, st02_code, st02_lot, st02_lot_seq, st02_gbn, st02_cus, st02_pno, st02_purno, st02_ipunt, st02_ipqty, st02_qrcode, st02_status, st02_stok, st02_dist, st02_opunt, st02_qty, st02_indte, st02_empno, st02_moq, st02_def_lot ) VALUES ( #{company}, #{factory}, CONCAT(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD'), lpad(#{st02Seq},5,'0')), TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{st02Seq}, #{cm08Code}, #{st02Lot}, #{st02LotSeq}, 'PU', #{st02Cus}, #{st02Pno}, CONCAT(#{st02Pno},lpad(#{st02Seq},5,'0')), #{st02Ipunt}, #{st02Ipqty}, #{st02Qrcode}, #{st02Status}, #{st02Stok}, #{st02Dist}, '', 0, sysdate, #{st02Empno}, #{st02Moq} #{st02DefLot} )
